mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market tightness that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and suppressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and retail sales financing indicates weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20d SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in real economic output, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate indicates persistent inflationary pressure that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, suppressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative 20d SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor demand, which raises wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to a delayed Fed tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k for 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxy: RSAFS) combined with a falling housing market (HOUST) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative 60d SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average signals a weakening in real economic output, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below its 12-month MA, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
